item.title: CIFOS 2-Wheels Festival Happening This November 27-29
item.description: After setting new records at its 4-Wheels Festival last October , the Clark International Festival of Speed (CIFOS) is preparing for another big weekend. This time, it’s the motorcycle community’s turn as the CIFOS 2-Wheels Festival returns to Clark International Speedway on November 27 to 29, 2026.
